title: The taxi complaints closed before anyone processed them

beats.text: San Francisco auditors found more than 500 taxi complaints closed without being processed.

visual.sub: SFMTA asked 311 to close more than 500 complaints without processing them

beats.text: One employee handled intake. There was no adequate backup.

visual.kicker: SFMTA asked 311 to close more than 500 complaints without processing them

beats.text: The City’s two systems differed by 1,318 records across two fiscal years.
Staff also found about 150 online complaints outside the telephone workflow.

visual.kicker: The two systems differed by 1,318 complaints in two fiscal years

beats.text: The agency said it assigned eight investigators to retrieve complaints daily.

visual.kicker: The agency changed how complaints were assigned

beats.text: By April 2015, 36 of 42 recommendations across the audit had been implemented.

visual.kicker: The agency changed how complaints were assigned

beats.text: We checked the public register. Its exact taxi complaint category begins in 2024.

visual.kicker: The public category cannot reproduce the old audit counts

beats.text: That category contains 659 records through November 26, 2026.

visual.kicker: The public category cannot reproduce the old audit counts
Most recent closed tickets still said the investigation was pending

beats.text: Yet 617 closed records still said pending investigation.
It takes the investigator’s decision to tell what happened after intake.
